decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample shift near index 489–492 with coordinated N/E drop and U rise, possibly a transient offset or jump onset; (2) a sustained quasi-platform from 605–615 after a steep descent, where cross-axis coherence suggests a temporary stabilization or opposing superposition. No other windows show similarly structured morphology.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 489–492, with U showing a concurrent rise; appears as a possible abrupt offset or platform onset, not fully resolved by coarse windowing.

Extended plateau-like behavior in all axes from ~607 to 615, following a steep descent in U and E; ambiguous whether this is a true platform or superposed opposing trends—surroundings show prior rapid motion and subsequent continuation of drift.
